name: RoboForm
summary: RoboForm has one Business plan at $39.95 per user a year, and that plan includes single sign-on and SCIM provisioning. Self-hosting is offered only on the quoted Enterprise plan for environments of 1,000 or more users.

facts.text: Vault data is encrypted with AES-256 using a key derived from the master password with PBKDF2 SHA-256, and decryption happens on the user's device.
Secfault Security audited and penetration-tested RoboForm in 2023 and 2025, and RoboForm publishes executive summaries of both reviews.
SCIM provisioning with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and OneLogin is part of the Business license at no extra charge.
In a 2018 statement, Siber Systems said RoboForm fully complies with GDPR.
New business accounts get a 14-day trial for up to 30 users, with one 5-day extension after it ends.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Volume pricing; adds self-hosting for 1,000 or more users

hiddenCosts: Card and PayPal renewals are charged 14 days before the license expires.

contract.cancellation: Automatic renewal can be turned off; business licenses are not refundable.
contract.dataExport: RoboForm's extended CSV format, covering logins, notes, form fields, TOTP keys and passkeys.
